user_saw: A malformed session key returned HTTP 200 and sent the job to a fallback session, while a transform requesting an immediate wake could leave it deferred until the next heartbeat.
summary: The fix rejects explicitly supplied malformed agent-hook session keys with HTTP 400 and honors immediate wake overrides in both wake and agent hook transforms.
reasoning: The earliest available checkout snapshot already normalized malformed agent session keys without rejecting them and only honored transform overrides toward next-heartbeat. The fix PR attributes the defects to two different older commits, but neither revision was available locally and the full-history path search stopped at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify their diffs or establish whether either behavior had worked before.
